key_points.text: Founded in the UK in 1905 under the name Wilsdorf & Davis, Rolex has become the leading name in luxury watches.
But, while the company’s products are iconic, the business itself is highly secretive.
Owned by a Foundation and run as a non-profit entity, little is known about Rolex.
